interactiveWorkspaceV2.method: Chrome Headless Shell 157.0.8103.78 on macOS, separate temporary sender and receiver profiles with separate loopback HTTP origins for preset transfer. Workspace and virtualized selection suites also launch the local HTML file in fresh profiles. The browser writes real preset files, reads their bytes back, and dispatches pointer, keyboard and file-picker interactions. Pixel readbacks compare rasterized canvases.
interactiveWorkspaceV2.scope: The HTML prototype simulates photographic file delivery. Large-sample timings use three local fixtures and virtualized rows. The native application enforces 2,000 checked input IDs for rendered files, original copies and manifest-only delivery.
